# awscc_iotsitewise_workspace (Resource)

Represents an AWS IoT SiteWise workspace that provides logical isolation for tasks and pipelines.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `encryption_configuration` (Attributes) The encryption configuration for the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--encryption_configuration))
- `workspace_name` (String) The name of the workspace.

### Optional

- `kms_key_id` (String) The ARN of the AWS KMS key used for KMS_BASED_ENCRYPTION. Required when EncryptionConfiguration.EncryptionType is KMS_BASED_ENCRYPTION.
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `workspace_description` (String) A description of the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the workspace was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The current state of the workspace.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the workspace was last updated.
- `workspace_arn` (String) The ARN of the workspace.

<a id="nestedatt--encryption_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `encryption_configuration`

Required:

- `encryption_type` (String) The type of encryption.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iotsitewise_workspace.example
  identity = {
    workspace_arn = "workspace_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `workspace_arn` (String) The ARN of the workspace

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iotsitewise_workspace.example
  id = "workspace_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_iotsitewise_workspace.example "workspace_arn"
```
